title: Universal cochain normalization of ramified scalar comparison
statement: Given the actual ramified system scalar realization and its ordinary tensor-unit normalization [def-sf-ramified-system-scalar-realization-data], define RamifiedScalarNormalization to mean the following equality on every normalized system M, every cochain complex C and every identification M≅Q(C): the ramified comparison followed by the universal scalar counit equals the whole-system scalar counit, exact cofinal-localization factorization, and localization of the ordinary comparison, in that order. Thus the map is specified before total limit and not inferred from equality of its finite components.

lean.statement: def RamifiedScalarNormalization {E L : FieldStage.{u} B.l} {i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic B.l] L.carrier} {e : ℕ+} {he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification B.l E.carrier L.carrier i e} {W : Scheme.{u}} {RE : Reconstruction B E W} {RL : Reconstruction B L W} {S : Scalar B.l B.Qbar (s := .integral E) (t := .integral L) (PurCompactSupport.completedChange B.l E.carrier L.carrier i) W} {T : SystemScalar B E L i W RE RL S} (r : RamifiedScalar B i e he W T) (o : RamifiedOrdinaryNormalization B r) : Prop
